title: NVIDIA Spectrum-X: Hardware-Accelerated Multiplane Networking for Large-Scale AI Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.21187v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As distributed model training scales to span hundreds of thousands of GPUs, scale-out networks face unprecedented performance and efficiency demands. NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet has been designed from the ground up to achieve predictable and stable network performance with high utilization and low latency. This paper presents the Spectrum-X multiplane architecture, which replaces hierarchical depth with topological parallelism, and introduces hardware-accelerated load balancing in NICs and switches as the key architectural approach to provide fast reaction to highly dynamic network conditions at the microsecond timescales that AI training workloads demand. We describe the motivation, design principles, evaluation methodology and performance on state-of-the-art benchmarks, as well as the lessons we learned from deploying and debugging Spectrum-X networks in large-scale systems. translated_title: NVIDIA Spectrum-X：面向大规模AI训练的硬件加速多平面网络
translated_abstract: 随着分布式模型训练的规模扩展到跨越数十万个GPU，横向扩展网络面临着前所未有的性能和效率需求。NVIDIA Spectrum-X以太网从底层设计出发，旨在实现可预测且稳定的网络性能，同时兼具高利用率和低延迟。本文介绍了Spectrum-X多平面架构，该架构以拓扑并行性取代层次化深度，并在网卡和交换机中引入硬件加速的负载均衡作为关键架构方法，从而在AI训练工作负载所需的微秒级时间尺度上，对高度动态的网络状况做出快速响应。我们阐述了其设计动机、设计原则、评估方法以及在最先进基准测试上的性能表现，并分享了在大规模系统中部署和调试Spectrum-X网络所获得的经验教训。我们的评估凸显了生产级AI基础设施……
tldr: NVIDIA Spectrum-X通过多平面架构以拓扑并行性取代层次化深度，并借助网卡和交换机中的硬件加速负载均衡，在微秒级时间尺度上快速响应动态网络状况，为数十万GPU规模的大规模AI训练提供可预测、稳定、高利用率且低延迟的网络性能。
